changes.title: Law-firm website census first published
changes.summary: 123,823 US law-firm websites read (of 1,101,164 websites visited): the share with Spanish-language pages, online booking, live chat, LegalService or review markup, HTTPS and 24/7 intake, by state and practice area, and websites with Spanish pages per 100,000 Spanish-speaking residents with limited English.
